verdict.rationale: Unleash documents role-based access control at root and project levels, with predefined and custom roles for permission management; custom roles are Enterprise-only. It also documents API tokens scoped to specific projects and a single environment. However, the scoped tokens shown are backend SDK tokens for reading flag configuration, not tokens that limit who can change flags. The evidence also never shows permissions finer than the project level, such as per-flag or per-environment write access. missing for 10: documented per-flag or per-environment change permissions, scoped admin/write API tokens, detail on individual permission granularity, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can restrict who can change which flags with roles, permissions, and scoped API tokens

citations.quote: Unleash implements role-based access control at root and project levels, with predefined and custom roles for precise permission management.
Enterprise users can create their own custom root roles and custom project roles.
Backend tokens are scoped to one or more projects and a single environment.
When creating a backend token, you can give it access to a specific list of projects or to all current or future projects.
